name: Master Fortune Teller
body:
Prerequisites: Profession (fortune teller) 10 ranks, Tap Fortune.

Benefit: You may use harrowing (as the spell) once per day as a spell-like ability. Treat your ranks in Profession (fortune teller) as your caster level for this ability. You must have a harrowing deck to use this ability.
